The '''Avidich system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Avidich/Legends|Avidich]], which was used by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] to cultivate edible [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]].
